notes.title: Big update!
notes.content:
Hi players!

We have now hit the first milestone improving the Wave Rewards feature and making more Steam Achievements along with adding frequent fixes and quality of life improvements!

Now you will see varied selection of resources and traps in Wave Rewards. In Endless mode you will get to pick new Endless cards and there's also a Stats panel where you can see how you have improved your Endless run. Our focus is on continual improvement based on feedback and wishes from testers & players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41891200/5dad310c436b97818d1d8d46a194ce532272b820.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41891200/fb06f39fb9c13a02a46979663307a9381b2cac37.jpg[/img]
 
Quality of Life improvements
- It's now more clear when you can go pick new Skill Cards from the Skill Cards button
- Get rewards (eyes/stars/leaderboard rankings) from a battle even if you quit the application mid-game
- You can select whether to open update panel when placing a trap (in accessibility options)
- Game stability improvements on high endless boss waves
- Slimes and target dummies are explained in tutorials (levels 9 & 14)

Other:
- Fixes and improvements for gameplay interactions, bugs, texts, UI, graphics, game feel, sounds, stuttering

What interesting comes in the coming months?
- We have designed exciting tactical trap which will be revealed later
- Background story will be expanded. Can't wait for this!
- We'll release another set of achievements along with interesting player statistics that show in your profile
- Better way to track picked cards

If you have played the game please give feedback in our Discord or Steam forums. Thanks for giving the game a go. We'll stay busy developing it. At ease, battlers!

-Adventure Toe

notes.title: Patch 0.7.28 is here!
notes.content:
Hello Astro Battlers! 
New week, new patch.

[b]Game Update notes Build 0.7.28[/b]

[list]
[*] Skill Cards screen buttons rework: offers more helpful info & unlocks after first level
[*] New Player Bundle added to shop: 5000 eyes, 100 coins, 2 of each ultimate
[*] Level 1 rework: Player needs to move kid to right lane at start, different waves & scripted starting skill cards & scenario for future Story bit
[*] Added option when planting to open update panel automatically
[*] Enemies wait a bit when reaching the kid and they can be sniped with laser ultimate during that time
[*] Fixed laser ultimate range: it can now hit enemies that are about to win
[*] Fixed shooting pattern on Opening Burst
[*] Fixed bomb stopping high health enemies after detonation
[*] Worms don't flicker on top of each other
[*] Spikes and bomb can be planted on enemy squares again
[*] Fix for planting during Wave Reward Cards (was lost in version control sorry!)
[*] Adjusted Popcorn drops from enemies
[*] Added Update Point particles to clarify when new Update Points are gained
[*] UI Text changes
[/list]

Have a nice weekend!

- Adventure Toe

notes.title: Early Access Launch July 28!
notes.content:
Hi folks!

We are happy to announce that Astro Battlers TD will be launched end of this week, July 28. And it will be [b]Free To Play[/b]!

Our Early Access version will include:
[list]
[*]  40 normal levels
[*]  17 hard levels
[*]  3 endless game challenges
[*]  + 600 enemy variations
[*]  + 50 Skill Cards
[*]  Ingame Shop
[/list]

This is our plan for EA. While mostly our content is done, we want to focus on quality of life updates.
So we encourage you to write feedback and reviews to make it even better for you guys!

[b]UPDATE 1[/b]
Endless game optimization
New endless game wave reward cards
Achievement updates 1/3
Trading cards
Hot fixes

[b]UPDATE 2[/b]
Level Builder early test
Hot fixes
Achievement updates 2/3

[b]UPDATE 3[/b]
Hot fixes
Achievement updates 3/3
New Skill Cards
Full controller support
Shop optimization

[b]UPDATE 4[/b]
Hot fixes
Final version of level builder
Shared Levels
Localization

Thank you!
